The target must accept this phone\'s ADB key. Normally it asks with an \"Allow USB debugging?\" prompt. If that prompt never appears or the target hangs up, run this command on the rooted target (for example in Termux), then tap Start again:\n\n%1$s
Something not working? The connection log shows every step and what the other device answered. The app log is this app\'s own system log. No root needed.
Every connection step, the shell commands sent and everything the other device and the scrcpy server printed.

Bundled upstream server: v5.0.1. Audio needs Android 10 or newer on the target device. Recording, camera capture, USB/OTG and desktop window flags are not part of this Android viewer.
Choose a YouTube-style floating player or full-screen mirroring. Android may ask for permission to display over other apps.

No control disables remote touch, key, wake-on-connect and turn-screen-off-on-connect commands. Power off on close remains a server cleanup option.
